gaps.explanation: Every governmental fund is in detail (budget schedules pp9-16). Per fund (statement p4 vs detail): General 208,627 vs 208,627 (p9); Street 1,764,950 vs 824,950 (p10); Debt Service 156,488 vs 156,488 (p11); Other Governmental Funds 221,777 vs Police 56,811 + Fire 43,460 + Library 35,942 + Park & Rec 85,564 + Keno 0 = 221,777 (pp12-16). The whole gap of 940,000 is the Street Fund bond principal: the statement prints it in Debt service Principal (Street column 940,000, p4), while the Street budget schedule prints it as 'Bond payments' (940,000) under Other Financing Sources (p10), which is in detail as an other-financing line (detail index 24). The money is already in detail, so the statement's Principal 940,000 is not added; the printed label/section is kept. Nothing counted twice.

Detail 535,451 = Water budget 219,001 + depreciation 50,178, Sewer budget 135,708 + depreciation 58,165, Garbage budget 71,900 + depreciation 499. Statement 528,696 (p7). Difference -6,755 = Sewer Fund budget schedule 'Capital outlay' 6,755 (p18), which the proprietary statement capitalizes (cash flow capital and related financing (6,755), p8). Printed on the budget schedule; kept.

debt_proceeds 1,545,000 = Proceeds of refunding bonds, Street Fund column (p5) = detail 'Bond proceeds' 1,545,000 (p10). The schedule figure 605,000 nets the Street budget schedule's 'Bond payments' (940,000) (p10, detail index 24), printed under other financing on the schedule but as Debt service Principal on the statement (p4). Same 940,000 as the expenditure gap; nothing missing.
